verdict.rationale: Databricks clearly ships versioned REST APIs: the reference hub lists versions side by side (e.g. Jobs v2.0), paths are versioned (api/2.0), and the docs recommend the latest version. It also publishes per-API deprecation notices with migration guides, such as the legacy SQL API moving off /api/2.0/preview/sql/queries and the CLI 0.18 to 0.205 migration. However, these are ad hoc notices; there is no documented platform-wide deprecation policy, and "support will end soon" gives no concrete timeline. missing for 10: a formal published deprecation policy with notice periods and sunset timelines, independent or hands-on corroboration of how deprecations play out in practice.
